title: The Glance: the first time I saw her 🌸
look: cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, smooth stabilized gimbal and steadicam camera movement, gentle slow motion, shallow depth of field, soft golden morning light, dreamy pink and warm gold colour grade, film grain, photorealistic, vertical 9:16, no text. The place is a quiet tree-lined street in Bangalore in spring, both sides lined with pink trumpet trees (Tabebuia rosea, Bangalore's cherry blossoms) in full bloom, a canopy of pink flowers overhead, pink petals falling slowly and carpeting the road. The same two people and the same dog in every shot. He is the young man: an original fictional character, a 25-year-old South Indian man, slim, youthful boyish face, short wavy black hair, clean-shaven with only very light stubble (no beard), warm brown eyes, a crisp white linen shirt with sleeves rolled up, beige chinos, a brown leather camera strap with a black mirrorless camera. She is the young woman: an original fictional character, a 24-year-old South Indian woman, long wavy black hair, a small black bindi, bright eyes, a soft mustard-yellow cotton kurta, white palazzo pants, a long pale white chiffon scarf (dupatta) draped around her neck and over her shoulders, her hair uncovered and open, a tan canvas tote bag on one shoulder. The dog is the dog: a playful, fluffy cream-and-tan Indian street dog (indie) with perky ears, a curly tail and a red collar

shots.prompt: Establishing shot with NO people at all: a slow crane shot drifting down through a canopy of pink trumpet blossoms over the empty Bangalore street, petals falling in slow motion, morning sun through the flowers, the road completely empty
He stands alone under the pink trees and lifts his camera to photograph the falling blossoms, focused and smiling, petals drifting past
Surprise: the fluffy indie dog leaps up out of nowhere, grabs the black lens cap dangling from his camera in its mouth and dashes away down the petal-covered street, tail wagging
He runs after the dog down the blossom street, laughing in disbelief, one hand holding his camera, petals swirling around him
The dog stops at her feet and drops the lens cap; she crouches down, laughing, and picks it up, petting the dog's head
He arrives out of breath; she looks up at him and their eyes meet for the first time, both freeze, the dog sitting between them, pink petals falling
Close-up: she looks down shyly with a small smile, holding the lens cap, and strokes the dog's ears
The cheeky dog grabs the end of her long white scarf in its mouth and starts running in a circle around the two of them, tail wagging
The white scarf wraps around both of them as the dog circles, pulling them close together, face to face, both surprised and laughing
Close two-shot: they burst into laughter, untangling the white scarf, the dog jumping happily at their feet
She hands him back the lens cap with a smile; he glances down at his camera screen, then hesitates, a little embarrassed
Twist: he turns the camera screen to her: the photo is not of the blossoms, it is a photo of her he took earlier; she covers her smile with her hand, delighted
They walk side by side slowly down the blossom street, talking and smiling, the dog trotting proudly ahead with the white scarf in its mouth
Final shot: the dog stops in the foreground, turns and looks straight into the camera with the white scarf in its mouth, tail wagging, as the couple walks away behind it under the pink blossoms

description:
He came to photograph the blossoms. A dog had other plans. 🌸🐕

The first glance under Bangalore's pink trumpet trees.
